sites.boundary: The page's one review handler: it answers core's prompt only with the person's choice in the review dialog, cancels on a scope or account change, and closes when core withdraws the prompt.
The page reader's transport adds the page's abort signal to each public RPC read; never a wallet RPC.
The Signa connector's read callback forwards public reads to the Center RPC transport for Base; Signa's own wallet signs and refuses writes here.

The app adapter acquires the explicitly current connector, retries replacement during acquisition, and invokes after synchronous reviewed account, chain and Safe-route checks. Only proven pre-invocation failures release the SDK hold.
